answer: Problem: sybil clones appear at scale to dilute peer weight. Mechanism: each entrant locks a time-bonded stake and must gather three domain-disjoint seals before ranking counts, weaving pigment, lotus, and glacier into the workflow with concrete receipts. Cost: capital locked one full epoch plus seal bandwidth; early exit burns 2.5% of principal. Verification: panels recompute the bond root and drop seals without matching on-ledger work receipts. Failure: incomplete seals at close burn the bond and keep the clone weightless.
